lines.t: When the noise of life grows loud, I will come and bow down low
Lay my burdens at your feet, in your gentle peace I know
You calm my soul to quiet streams You lead me where the stillness grows
I do not have to carry on When your mercy overflows
Trusting Yahushua, Lord of rest In your presence I am blessed
You are holy, you are near Come my heart and cast out fear
I push you a day and night, you are my shalom, my light
I will rest beneath your hand, safe within your holy plan
Work can wait, the world can pause
I will enter sacred rest Every anxious thought grows still
In the one who knows me best Teach my heart to breathe in grace
Set my spirit free to stay In the sweetness of your rest
I am made new in your way
Trust in Yahushua, Lord of rest
In your presence I am blessed
You are holy, you are near
Call my heart and cast out fear
Trust in Yahushua, day and night
You are my, shall own my life
I will rest beneath your hand
Safe within your holy plan
